title: Viewer-Requested Extreme Killer Sudoku
description:
Mark talks us through the explanation for a killer sudoku requested by Mario Nigrovic.  It's rated 10 for difficulty, and certainly deserves that!

You can try the puzzle here in our software: https://sudokupad.app/BqLb9nf9q2 

One note on Mark's solve:  at 5mins he states that a 1/6 are forced over into r3c7/8/9 - when actually a 6 could still go in r7c1 at this point.  There are a variety of ways to prove that the 6 is forced over eg note that a 5 is locked into r8 or r9 in the bottom right nonet AND also the bottom middle nonet.  This means there must be a 5 in r7c3 - which in turn rules out a 6 from r7c1.  From here on Mark's logic can be followed again.
